startupErrorBody: The browser refused access to local storage. This is usually temporary — private browsing and a full disk are the common causes.
storageWriteFailedToast: Not saved. Check your storage and try again.
onboardingSubtitle: Everything stays on this device. No account, no server.
homeEmptySubtitle: Tap the button below to write your first note.
settingsStorageSafe: Your browser has promised to keep this app's data.
settingsStorageAtRisk: The browser may clear this app's data when space runs low. Installing the app to your home screen makes it much less likely.
pwaUpdatingBody: A new version just arrived. This takes a second.
pwaInstallBodyIos: Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
pwaInstallBodyAndroid: Add it to your home screen to open it like any other app.
crashBody: Your data is safe — nothing was lost. Try opening the screen again.
backupBody: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to back up yet.} one {# note on this device. A backup file is the only copy you own.} other {# notes on this device. A backup file is the only copy you own.}}
backupRestoreScope: {count, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}}, {from} to {to}.
backupRestoreWarning: Everything on this device will be replaced.
backupRestoreFailed: The restore did not go through. Your data is unchanged.
backupErrorNotABackup: That is not a backup from this app.
backupErrorVersion: That backup was made by a different version of the app.
backupErrorCorrupt: That backup has damaged records, so none of it was used.
